title: Implant stability in patients treated with platelet -rich fibrin and bovine bone substitute for alveolar ridge preservation is associated with peripheral blood cells and coagulation factors
authors: Brouwers JEIG, van der Vorm LN, Buis S, Haumann R, Karanzai A, Konings J, de Groot PG, de Laat B, Remijn JA. Clin Exp Dent Res. 2020 Apr;6(2):236-243. doi: 10.1002/cre2.263.
supports: Clinical study from the botiss cerabone (sintered bovine bone) literature list — the product featured in it, which is not the same as the study being about the product, so check the design and the comparator before citing it as product evidence. Authors' conclusion, verbatim: “Implant stability following alveolar ridge preservation with PRF and bovine bone substitute is associated with circulating blood cells and coagulation factors. In particular, fibrin structure, VWF, and FXIII may be important modulators of implant stability” This records what the paper says, not what a rep may say: the sales wording still has to pass the claim tiers, and a study in one indication licenses nothing in another.
